display.purpose: Home hero headline only; one italic turn allowed.

quote.purpose: Lead testimonial with hanging rose-ink quote marks.

lead.purpose: The sentence under every heading; Hanken 300, soft graphite, 34-46ch.

body.purpose: Running text; 60-62ch caps on prose and answers.

label.purpose: Field labels, nav, captions; footer headings at 600.

shadows.name: nav-float
shadows.purpose: Floating nav pill once scrolled; at top it is 60% white with no ring.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary pill button; small variant has none.

shadows.name: frost
shadows.purpose: Nav pill (mobile menu uses blur(24px) over 94% white).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for every transition and the draw-in.

motion.name: draw-stroke
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0 over 2.4s, stagger 70ms per element
motion.purpose: Illustration strokes draw in on first view (foliage first).

motion.name: draw-wash
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1 over 1.6s, scale 0.96 to 1 over 2s, delay 0.2s

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all durations 0.01ms; no motion class added

filters.recipe: displacement warp (0.018, scale 26); two merged translucent passes masked by pooling noise (0.011); paper grain (0.85); darker drying edge from eroded ring (radius 3.2, 72% luminance) masked by low-frequency drift noise (0.006). Same recipe, different seeds.

components.name: Botanical Rose on Wash
components.description: Signature imagery: graphite line rose (contour 1.7, hairline 0.85, stem 1.1, non-scaling) over a filtered watercolour wash, in a rose art frame.

narrative.northStar: The Botanical Plate on White Paper
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Botanical Plate on White Paper"**

The premium florist canon, played straight. The page is quiet white paper and the flowers are the only loud thing on it: botanical line drawings in graphite ink laid over translucent watercolour washes of rose and sage. Everything else (type, buttons, dividers) recedes into a graphite-on-white register so the drawings carry the brand.

Density is low and editorial. Sections breathe on a large fluid rhythm, structure comes from hairline rules rather than boxes, and dusty rose takes over whole sections as the single field colour. Type pairs a high-contrast Bodoni Moda display, often turning one phrase italic, with a light, open Hanken Grotesk for reading. The one interactive voice is the graphite pill button with a nested arrow circle, which always leads to WhatsApp.

Motion is a single moment: the illustration strokes draw themselves in on first view, then fills and washes settle. Nothing else animates on scroll.
keyCharacteristics: White paper ground; rose (#f3e3e0) owns whole sections; graphite is ink, never a field.
Imagery is inline SVG line art over watercolour washes, not photography (photo slots are placeholders until real photos exist).
Bodoni Moda display with optical sizing and one italic turn per headline; Hanken Grotesk 300 leads, 400 body.
Pill geometry for every control; large soft frames for art and the form card.
Hairline dividers instead of cards; shadows only on floating or pressable things.

rules.name: The Rose Field Rule
rules.body: Rose is the only colour that fills a section. Graphite stays ink (text, strokes, the button) and is never a section background; sage appears as a field only in the plants art frame.

rules.name: The Rose-Ink Accent Rule
rules.body: Every small accent, from focus ring to numeral to leader dot, is rose-ink. Do not introduce a second accent hue for UI details.

rules.name: The Italic Turn Rule
rules.body: A display headline may turn one phrase italic (weight 400), never more; the turn stays graphite. Italic in rose-ink is reserved for the wordmark, service subheads, step numerals and the current mobile-menu item.

rules.name: The Light Lead Rule
rules.body: The sentence directly under a heading is always Hanken 300 in soft graphite; body copy is 400. Never set leads bold or in the display face.

rules.name: The Hairline Over Box Rule
rules.body: Group content with 1px graphite hairlines (14% or 32%) and space. The form card is the only bordered, shadowed container.

dos: **Do** let rose-field own whole sections, alternating with white paper; never set two rose sections back to back.
**Do** draw new imagery from the existing symbol sprite: ink in 1.7 / 1.1 / 0.85 non-scaling strokes, fills from the botanical palette, washes through the watercolour filters at about 0.7 opacity.
**Do** use rose-ink for every small accent (focus, numerals, dots, ticks, tags).
**Do** route every primary action through the graphite pill button with its nested arrow circle.
**Do** separate content with hairlines and space; reserve shadow for the nav pill, the primary button and the form card.
**Do** keep motion to the one draw-in moment and honour reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use graphite or sage as a full-section background; rose is the only field colour.
**Don't** saturate the illustration palette or draw strokes in a colour other than graphite.
**Don't** lay products out as shop-grid card rows, price tiles or discount banners.
**Don't** add scroll reveals to sections or text; only the illustrations animate in.
**Don't** turn more than one phrase of a headline italic, or set leads heavier than 300.
**Don't** square off controls; buttons, chips, tags and nav are always full pills.
